title: Violinists and Big Eye Louis Nelson's reading
summary: Robinson lists violin players including Bocage, and discusses Big Eye Lewis and the importance of reading and executing.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Who was some of the violin players? Well, I could remember a good old man Robichaux and Peter Bucker and a guy who was and Peter Bocard and Jimmy Pollard. Well they had many more other violin players, I didn't know it, I think. Yeah. Yeah, I didn't know it. Who did Peter Bocard play with? Well Peter was, they had a band, the Superior Band, you understand, him and Bunk Johnson. Did you see the picture of Watson? Yeah, well you know Bunker knows that. Yeah. Big Eye Lewis. He was playing violin then, you understand?

Mmhmm. One time I was talking to Joe Robichaux and he says he saw Big Eye Lewis with his dad, his uncle's band, and he said he didn't know that Big Eye wasn't any musician, he thought Big Eye was reading all those poets and he just faked them. Well at the time Daniel, let me

take the time, see Big, he meets every fellow there, you see, he gets with a bunch of musicians like that, and he can play something there, the music, you understand? You can disqualify that, know what I mean? Mmhmm. You can disqualify them, you understand? Then you meet the fellow there, what can know the music, and get there and he can't play it. Yeah. You understand? You see? And it's supposed to keep that fellow there, what you know good and well, he got to do what you're trying to do, and you got to understand, and get the fellow there, and he know it, then he can't do it. That's a trouble. Yeah. You see? That's why I say, a fellow, it's good for a fellow to read and everything, but if you read, if you read, if you read and you can't read and you can't execute, you ain't know where. Mmhmm. You ain't know where cause you'll now have to follow up with the fellow king, you'll now get. You see? You'll now get. Mmhmm. You'll now get. Mmhmm.
